headline: Why TransDigm (TDG) Stock Is Trading Up Today
summary: Shares of aerospace and defense company TransDigm (NYSE:TDG) jumped 4.1% in the afternoon session after the company announced it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Prince & Izant for approximately $1.066 billion in cash.
